title: OnePageDocs project config
description: Optional onepage-docs.json in the folder opened with OnePageDocs. All fields are optional.

title.description: Header and tab title. Defaults to the folder name.

language.description: UI language. Defaults to the browser language.

docsRoot.description: Docs folder relative to the opened folder. "auto" = docs/ if present, else the folder itself.

includeOutside.description: Also show .md files outside docsRoot as the last group.

groups.description: Order and labels of sidebar groups. A group is a first-level folder inside docsRoot; "" is docsRoot itself.

pin.description: File names (without .md) or paths shown first in their group.

last.description: File names (without .md) or paths shown last in their group.

skip.description: Folder names not scanned (added to the built-in list).

generatedMarker.description: Text that marks a file as generated by a script.

status.description: Case-insensitive regexes that colour property values. Checked in order bad → warn → ok.
